opening.argument: The description ties a concrete viewer action to an immediate monetary benefit: it says to sign up for TradingView and get $15 instantly. That is more than a general mention of a platform; it pairs registration through a linked destination with a promised reward. The description does not state the offer's conditions, so a viewer cannot assess from this material what qualifies or whether the benefit is available to them. That missing context makes the sign-up pitch a meaningful reason to scrutinize the promotion rather than treat it as incidental.
